updates.text: Imported all 51 findings, 21 ticket drafts and 35 screenshots. Recorded the code-review notes and agreed direction. Implementation and planning have not started.

Added explicit batch acceptance checklists without changing the original ticket drafts. T-13 removes search from the Ask flow while keeping keyword search separately in Wardrobe. T-15 and T-05 retain rotation, countdown and recognition follow-ups. Every completed ticket now requires before/after image pairs.

Captured and visually reviewed nine before/after pairs (18 images) from synthetic fixtures. All 755 unit tests passed; native acceptance is running. Tracker image loading, 320/390/1440 px layouts, search and no-JavaScript comparisons passed.

Full batch gate passed on c05071e: 755 unit tests and 29 native tests (1,276 assertions). Native journeys verified chat entry/resumption, saving from the compact board action and finishing paired capture. The preview deployment is next.
